Airacom Limited.note: Airacom Limited operates as an independent business voice, data, and technology services provider.

Asset Monitoring Solutions Ltd.note: Asset Monitoring Solutions Ltd was acquired by RAM Tracking in October 2020.

Brigade Electronics Group Plc.note: Brigade Electronics Group Plc remains an independent, unfunded company founded by Chris Hanson-Abbott OBE and has not been acquired.

Chevin Fleet Solutions.note: Chevin Fleet Solutions was acquired by Volaris Group in August 2023.

Cordic.note: Cordic was acquired by Cab Guru in January 2023 and integrated under the CabFusion brand.

Digital INNK Limited.note: Digital INNK Limited remains an independent private company operating its fleet platform under its original brand.

Exeros Technologies Ltd.note: Exeros Technologies Ltd is an active, independent company founded by Jay Biring and Joe Williams, and it raised growth funding from Pembroke VCT in 2025 rather than being acquired.

Fleetbooks Limited.note: Fleetbooks Limited is a bootstrapped fleet management and vehicle tracking platform founded by Dawood Awan and has never been acquired.

Flock Mobility.note: Flock Mobility is an active, independent startup led by co-founders Terry Yoell and Aaron Mason, and backed by investors such as Gareth Williams.

Jaama Ltd.note: Lexana Capital Limited acquired Jaama Limited on June 30, 2023.

Meta Trak UK Limited.note: Formerly known as Westatec Telematics Limited until March 2026.

REM Trading LTD.note: RAM Tracking acquired Rewire Security (REM Trading LTD) in May 2022.

Trakm8 Limited.note: Trakm8 Ltd was acquired by Omegro Group in 2024.

VisionTrack Limited.note: VisionTrack Limited operates as part of the Markerstudy Group but is an acquirer rather than an acquired entity in the relevant period.

i247 Group Limited.note: Secured a minority private equity investment and backed a management buyout by LDC in 2026 rather than being fully acquired.
